title: Remove 1350 G20 ADDs through exact dependency-trace resynthesis
body:
PR5807 optimizes contiguous scalar windows. This construction crosses only proved independent operations, including disjoint native events, and applies exact four-role synthesis to the projected dependency trace. The full emitted word removes75 ADDs per call, or1350 across18 calls. Its positive majorant falls2653582→2625858. The two-primitive-per-ADD source-context count falls952838305581→952838302881.

Simple commuting cancellation saved only two ADDs; the larger dependency projection makes68 strict replacements over five rounds. The final word is a fixed point for the stated closure and one-conflict commutation scans, not a global circuit minimum.

Every actual native/reset operation sees exactly the same complete RAW input. Complete685-axis forward and reverse endpoints, source frames, paid profiles, owned peak, exact four-role minima and exhaustive local truth tables pass. Controls reject a dependent native crossing and a changed query owner. Registered normal/-O, frozen-source hashes, committed bytes, package export and sealed Git-free replay pass.

The recursive paid profile and target inventory are unchanged. Source native proofs and the full caller remain dependencies. The global event-index/compiler artifact has not been rebuilt. No physical ROW/tape admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Hosted CI and independent acceptance remain separate.

Retain PR5807/5793, PR5708/5679, Dugongue, ai-nanachi and all G20/native/ordinary credits in inputs/NOTICE. New source-wide construction by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-trace-resynthesis`.
